HKR.1.claim: On non-invertible Krohn-Rhodes wreath automaton A5 \wr U2 (L = 6..48, 10 classes), kr_wreath_ermoe_etf (learned U2 reset gates + template-free A5 discovery) achieves L48_bacc >= 0.98, a5_hom_err <= 1e-10, and beats unitary_only_ufr_etf (>= +0.40 at L48), causal_transformer, and gru_baseline.

HKR.2.claim: On A5 \wr U2 zero-replay continual learning (Keep {0..5} -> FT {6..9}), kr_wreath_ermoe_etf achieves forgetting_after_keep >= 0.98, forgetting_drop <= 0.01, and ft_acc >= 0.98, outperforming standard causal_transformer and gru_baseline (drop >= 0.30).

HKR.3.claim: On real 2-layer PyTorch Causal Transformer next-token representations over the non-group Bounded-Dyck + Reset language, unsupervised D-optimal epiplexity selection (B = 40, 80, 160; zero labels accessed during selection) beats uniform random by >= +0.05 balanced accuracy at B = 40 and B = 80 with higher or equal class coverage.

HKR.4.claim: On real 2-layer PyTorch Causal Transformer zero-replay continual learning (Keep {0..4} -> FT {5..7}), transformer_whitened_orth_etf achieves forgetting_after_keep >= 0.85, forgetting_drop <= 0.05, and ft_acc >= 0.80, beating transformer_standard_ft.

HKR.5.claim: On the continuous-state noisy 2D double-integrator POMDP (T = 5..80), active excitation (u != 0) achieves id_acc(T=80) >= 0.98 vs passive (u = 0) in [0.45, 0.55] with 0 Chebyshev violations; float64 U2 audit confirms det=0, and horn-fill counts verify A5 = 100% inner/outer vs U2 & C5 \wr U2 & A5 \wr U2 = 100% inner / <100% outer.
